directions.en: From Challenge Roundabout, follow the circular road to Dugbe.
directions.yo: Láti Challenge Roundabout, tẹ̀lé opopona yíyíká títí dé Dugbe.

directions.en: From Dugbe Market, move straight to Mokola — Dugbe–Mokola Road.
directions.yo: Láti Dugbe Market, lọ títí dé Mokola, Dugbe–Mokola Road ni.

directions.en: From Iwo Road Roundabout, head toward Ojoo — Iwo Road.
directions.yo: Láti Iwo Road Roundabout, lọ sí Ojoo, Iwo Road ni.

directions.en: From Bodija Market, continue towards UI — Bodija Road.
directions.yo: Láti Bodija Market, lọ sí UI, Bodija Road ni.

directions.en: From Agodi Secretariat, take the road toward Government House — Secretariat Road.
directions.yo: Láti Agodi Secretariat, gba opopona tó lọ sí Government House, Secretariat Road ni.

directions.en: From Challenge, follow the road toward Odo Ona — Challenge–Odo Ona Road.
directions.yo: Láti Challenge, tẹ̀lé opopona tó lọ sí Odo Ona, Challenge–Odo Ona Road ni.

directions.en: From Molete, move towards Oke Ado Market — Oke Ado Road.
directions.yo: Láti Molete, lọ sí Oke Ado Market, Oke Ado Road ni.

directions.en: From Ibadan Toll Gate, drive inward to Apata — Apata Road.
directions.yo: Láti Ibadan Toll Gate, wọlé sí Apata, Apata Road ni.

directions.en: From Eleyele Lake, continue toward Polytechnic — Eleyele Road.
directions.yo: Láti Eleyele Lake, lọ sí Polytechnic, Eleyele Road ni.
